visual_action: A three-panel video showing an interview between Donald Trump and an unidentified male interviewer in an office setting. The top panel is a medium shot of both men. The middle and bottom panels are successive close-ups of Donald Trump as he appears to be speaking.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is the subject of the video, shown in all three panels, including two close-ups. The on-screen text attributes a quote to him.

cast.name: unnamed interviewer
cast.evidence: Shown in the top panel sitting opposite Donald Trump. The on-screen text attributes a question to him.

on_screen_text.text: People who voted for you are saying they didn't sign up for this.
Well, they did sign up for it, actually.
This is what I campaigned on.

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue in the video. The on-screen text presents a purported exchange where an interviewer tells Donald Trump his voters "didn't sign up for this," and Trump replies, "Well, they did sign up for it, actually. This is what I campaigned on."
audio_music: A dramatic and ominous orchestral piece plays throughout the video. The TikTok sound label identifies it as "dance of the knights by sergei prokofiev".
editing_pacing: A sequence of three static shots, cutting from a two-shot of the interview to two successive close-ups on Donald Trump.
cultural_references: Dance of the Knights by Sergei Prokofiev
central_claim: Donald Trump callously admits that his voters knew what they were getting and should not be surprised by his actions.
intended_effect: To portray Donald Trump as arrogant and dismissive of his own supporters' potential regret, thereby generating negative sentiment towards him.
uncertainty_flags: The authenticity of the dialogue presented in the on-screen text is unknown; it is presented as a direct quote but is not actually spoken in the audio, and its source is not provided.
